reviewer_method: Independent saved-data arithmetic with standard library and NumPy; no environment/planner/model execution
confidence_scope: Finite-record arithmetic and scoped verdict only; no population superiority or timing-repeatability claim

C1_practical_increment.reason: Selected scenes improve versus Fixed3, but neither model establishes stable practical superiority over early Detour or original Detour.

C2_selected_unknown_outcomes.scope: Only executed selected actions and actual frozen trajectories; full-state matching and null unknown values verified.

PPO_or_DRL_increment.reason: Not tested; no RL updates or PPO runs. Two checkpoints are matched BC-stage models.

generalization_physical_feasibility_hard.reason: Not tested; old development scenes, proxy validation, one timing per combination.

what_results_support: 72 registered plans completed; all saved route lengths, J, allocations, final-best route identities, shared reward/work ledgers and exact-state teacher categories match source evidence and executor summaries.
Unqueried selected actions have both beneficial and wasteful outcomes; CE unqueried: 1/4 immediate best improvements; CE+gain: 3/7. Unknown teacher Q remains null.
CE+gain versus continued CE: J 3 wins/9 ties/0 losses; mean per-scene gain +0.098452 percentage points; mean shared return +0.059850, with higher complete time in 11/12 single observations.
Relative root STOP mean return: continued CE -0.014086 (1/7/4), CE+gain +0.045764 (5/0/7), early Detour +0.110854 (4/0/8).
Original Detour J is lower than both learned methods on all 12 cases; early Detour has better mean J/return than CE+gain and is faster on 12/12 single observations.
Existing trajectories show late-stop accounting gaps, conditional on prefix validation not rolling back. Negative raw suffix alone is not a negative STOP advantage.
what_results_dont_support: PPO/DRL benefit, independent generalization, broad superiority from a single paired BC checkpoint comparison.
All unknown actions are poor, zero/negative labels for unknown teacher values, or optimal Q estimates from immediate reward or frozen suffix.
A deployable optimal stopping policy from hindsight prefix selection, or learned quality safety attributable solely to the policy.
Stable timing superiority, inherent model-load speed differences, hard real time, 400 ms compliance, IK or physical feasibility.
missing_evidence: Fixed-budget counterfactual action coverage at identical states, including STOP semantics and horizon/depth definition.
New held-out scenes distinct from these reused development cases, training seeds/checkpoint replications and repeated complete timings.
Matched strong-rule, BC and actual RL comparisons before claiming RL increment.
Real calibration/IK and hard-deadline verification if physical or real-time claims are intended.
suggested_claim_revision: On 12 reused development scenes, frozen full-menu policies reveal both useful and wasteful previously unqueried actions; CE+gain improves some outcomes relative to continued CE while leaving action ranking and stopping inefficiencies, without established stable practical advantage over strong rules/planners.
